sentences.english: Every day, millions of tonnes of cargo move across the world.
sentences.dutch: Elke dag worden wereldwijd miljoenen tonnen vracht vervoerd.

sentences.english: By sea.
sentences.dutch: Over zee.

sentences.english: By road.
sentences.dutch: Over de weg.

sentences.english: By rail.
sentences.dutch: Over het spoor.

sentences.english: By air.
sentences.dutch: Door de lucht.

sentences.english: A voyage ends.
sentences.dutch: Een reis eindigt.

sentences.english: A vessel is nearly empty.
sentences.dutch: Een schip is bijna leeg.

sentences.english: What comes next?
sentences.dutch: Wat volgt daarna?

sentences.english: For a truck, an empty return means more than distance.
sentences.dutch: Voor een truck betekent leeg terugrijden meer dan afstand.

sentences.english: It means time and fuel.
sentences.dutch: Het kost tijd en brandstof.

groups.recognizedText: Every day millions of tons of cargo move across the world. By sea, by road, by rail, by air. A voyage ends, a vessel is nearly empty. What comes next? For a truck, an empty return means more than distance. It means time and fuel.

sentences.english: The next suitable cargo may already be waiting.
sentences.dutch: De volgende passende lading wacht misschien al.

sentences.english: The right people need to see it.
sentences.dutch: De juiste mensen moeten die kunnen vinden.

sentences.english: In Malaysia, a vessel is expected to become available.
sentences.dutch: In Maleisië komt naar verwachting een schip vrij.

sentences.english: Its operator records that future position.
sentences.dutch: De operator legt die toekomstige positie vast.

sentences.english: Not a live tracking promise.
sentences.dutch: Geen belofte van live tracking.

sentences.english: An operational estimate, ready for the next commercial conversation.
sentences.dutch: Een operationele inschatting voor het volgende commerciële gesprek.

sentences.english: Meanwhile, seventy-five thousand tonnes need to move from Indonesia to China.
sentences.dutch: Intussen moet vijfenzeventigduizend ton van Indonesië naar China worden vervoerd.

sentences.english: CargoMatch brings the opportunity into view, while protecting each party's commercial details.
sentences.dutch: CargoMatch maakt de kans zichtbaar en beschermt de commerciële gegevens van beide partijen.

sentences.english: One party sends interest.
sentences.dutch: Eén partij toont interesse.

sentences.english: The other decides whether to connect.
sentences.dutch: De ander beslist over de verbinding.

sentences.english: Permission comes first.
sentences.dutch: Toestemming komt eerst.

sentences.english: Only after mutual consent does the conversation open.
sentences.dutch: Pas na wederzijdse toestemming begint het gesprek.

sentences.english: An introduction, not a booking.
sentences.dutch: Een kennismaking, geen boeking.

groups.recognizedText: One party sends interest, the other decides whether to connect. Permission comes first, only after mutual consent as the conversation open. An introduction, not a book.

sentences.english: On the road, the same question begins before the current delivery is complete.
sentences.dutch: Op de weg speelt dezelfde vraag al voordat de huidige levering is afgerond.

sentences.english: The driver confirms when the assigned truck is expected to be empty.
sentences.dutch: De chauffeur bevestigt wanneer de toegewezen truck naar verwachting leeg is.

sentences.english: A suitable next load appears.
sentences.dutch: Een passende volgende lading verschijnt.

sentences.english: The driver sends the opportunity to the planner.
sentences.dutch: De chauffeur stuurt de kans naar de planner.

sentences.english: The planner reviews it and makes the commercial decision.
sentences.dutch: De planner beoordeelt de kans en beslist commercieel.

sentences.english: The driver focuses on the operation.
sentences.dutch: De chauffeur richt zich op de operatie.

sentences.english: Availability, timing, and practical requirements still need checking.
sentences.dutch: Beschikbaarheid, timing en praktische eisen moeten nog worden gecontroleerd.

sentences.english: People remain in control.
sentences.dutch: Mensen houden de regie.

groups.recognizedText: On the road, the same question begins before the current delivery is complete. The driver confirms when the assigned truck is expected to be empty. A suitable next load appears. The driver sends the opportunity to the planner. The planner reviews it and makes the commercial decision. The driver focuses on the operation, availability, timing and practical requirements still need checking. People remain in control.

sentences.english: Functional rail pilots explore the same approach, starting with available wagons in Duisburg.
sentences.dutch: Functionele spoorpilots verkennen dezelfde aanpak, met beschikbare wagons in Duisburg.

sentences.english: In the air cargo demo pilot, the question is unused space on a scheduled flight.
sentences.dutch: In de luchtvrachtdemopilot draait het om onbenutte ruimte op een geplande vlucht.

sentences.english: Amsterdam to Dubai.
sentences.dutch: Amsterdam naar Dubai.

sentences.english: Remaining weight and volume shown together, so suitable cargo can be considered.
sentences.dutch: Resterend gewicht en volume samen in beeld om passende lading te beoordelen.

sentences.english: These are fictional pilot scenarios, not live airline bookings or fully released rail services.
sentences.dutch: Dit zijn fictieve pilotscenario's, geen live vliegboekingen of volledig uitgerolde spoordiensten.

groups.recognizedText: Functional rail pilots explore the same approach, starting with available wagons in Duesburg. In the air cargo demo pilot, the question is unused space on a scheduled flight. sentences.english: Before the truck heads back.
sentences.dutch: Voordat de truck terugrijdt.

sentences.english: Before an opportunity passes.
sentences.dutch: Voordat een kans voorbijgaat.

sentences.dutch: CargoMatch.

sentences.english: Find the next load before capacity becomes empty.
sentences.dutch: Vind de volgende lading voordat capaciteit leeg komt te staan.

sentences.english: Discover CargoMatch.
